description: Schedules a post for a future date/time. Automatically converts local time using workspace/user timezone into UTC. Accepts mediaUrls (public URLs) or files (AI-generated images or uploaded files from chat up to 100MB). For large video files over 100MB, tell the user to provide a direct public file URL or use autoposter_get_media_upload_url.

accountIds.description: List of account IDs from autoposter_list_accounts.

content.description: Base text content of the post.

files.description: Optional files generated in chat or uploaded by user to attach to the post.

mediaIds.description: Optional list of existing media IDs from workspace media library (from autoposter_list_media).

mediaUrls.description: Optional public image or video URLs to attach (e.g. from autoposter_upload_media).

platformContent.description: Optional platform-specific content overrides (e.g. twitter, linkedin).

postType.description: Optional target format where applicable: 'post' (default feed post/carousel), 'reel' (Instagram or Facebook Reel; requires video), 'story' (Instagram or Facebook 24h Story; requires image or video), or 'shorts' (YouTube Shorts; vertical video under 60s). Ignored on platforms without format variants.

scheduledAt.description: Scheduled ISO timestamp or local datetime string, e.g. '2026-10-05T14:00:00'.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone (e.g. 'America/New_York'). If omitted, defaults to workspace or user timezone.

name: autoposter_schedule_post

scheduledPosts.description: List of scheduled posts per target account.

status.description: Status of the scheduled post ('scheduled' or 'pending_approval').

success.description: Whether the post was successfully scheduled.

title: Schedule Post
